under_18.label: under 18
under_18.note: Younger learner. Keep it friendly, and remind them to involve a parent for any payment.

18_30.label: 18 to 30
18_30.note: Comfortable with phones. Keep it brisk and friendly.

31_50.label: 31 to 50
31_50.note: Adult learner. Keep it practical and respectful of their time.

51_65.label: 51 to 65
51_65.note: Mature learner. Be patient, avoid slang and abbreviations, and keep sentences short.

65_plus.label: over 65
65_plus.note: Senior learner. Be extra patient and warm, use the simplest words, keep sentences very short, and never rush.

unknown.label: not given
unknown.note: Age not given. Use a patient, respectful and simple style.
